ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">You've already joined, with the join link or code, as an Observer.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">When the participants' briefing ends, the room screen shows the join code for them to scan.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">On a phone, there are three tabs: Exercise, Notes and Messages.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">On a laptop, the exercise is on the left, with Notes and Messages on the right.</prosody></voice></speak>
<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">You can log as many notes as you need.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">When the exercise ends, please answer the one-minute survey on your screen.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">Your notes stay open for up to five hours, but it's best to log them while they're fresh.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-13%">Please set your phone to Do Not Disturb, not flight mode, and keep it plugged in if you can. Thank you.</prosody></voice></speak>
